task: Assist interpretation of low-coverage already-measured perturbations in the existing Cai D14 cardiac-reprogramming dataset
scope: Retrospective application with existing data only; no new experiments, no broad model benchmark, no novel-target or functional-yield claim.
cohort: Per target and D14 batch, query eligibility n>=budget+10; all D14 targets with n>=5 in that batch provide allowed training inputs. All eligible queries simultaneously contribute only budget cells; all their remaining cells are reference-only. Nonquery targets contribute all existing cells. No response-based eligibility.
controls: Each batch/split NT cells are randomly divided into disjoint input and reference sets, floor(N/2) input and remainder reference; same split used by every method and both budgets. No reference controls enter fitting or selection.
model: Original aligned_raw single-target centered KRR estimator, equal-half uniform and response-aligned mixture of12 existing Cai prior kernels, intercept, nonnegative absolute-expression projection, float32 output. New fitted-response interface for already measured targets replaces original unseen-target entry assertion; not the OT transfer model.
alignment: All current input means, excluding all assayed targets and conservative Becn1/Ifnar2/Wwtr1 exclusions; no reference cells, full-query means, reference variance or phenotype labels.
inner_selection: Five cell folds within each target's allowed input cells. Refit response alignment in every inner fit. Score mean squared error of fixed cardiac8 mean absolute expression, equally weighted by target and fold. Select alpha from[0.01,0.1,1]; ties within1e-12 choose larger alpha. This is a task-specific selection adaptation from original target-holdout PDS.
minimal_comparators: Raw input cell mean; shrinkage c*x+(1-c)*mean_all_training_targets with c in[0,.25,.5,.75,1], nonnegative projection, same input-only inner selection; ties choose lower c. Including query in training mean matches the KRR intercept.
primary_endpoint: Fixed cardiac8 mean expression change relative to independently sampled input/reference NT. Raw published normalization preserved. Absolute cardiac expression error separately diagnoses control-reference noise.
evaluation: First compute paired errors for each query/split, average over20 splits within target-by-batch, then batches within target. Correlation and fixed top20percent candidate selection occur separately within each batch/split; never average predictions before evaluating against reference means. Whole-transcriptome non-target error is secondary.
uncertainty: 2000 paired target-cluster bootstrap draws preserving all batch and split rows; fixed predictions. Splits and cells are not independent biological replicates. Batch identities not mapped to independent animals.
biological_checks: Compare cardiac ranking, sign agreement, fixed top20percent candidate selected reference cardiac response, and retention of reference-positive upper-quintile responses. Independent reference data define evaluation labels only. Compare fitted amplitude and lowcoverage/raw response; do not claim success from generic contraction toward the mean.
success: Primary cardiac error improves against both raw and simple shrinkage with paired intervals supporting improvement; candidate ranking/selection remains useful and strong positive responses are retained. A generic error gain without cardiac decision benefit is not a positive cardiac application. The10-cell sensitivity must not materially reverse the interpretation. Report exact effect sizes and uncertainty, not only a pass flag.
information_retention_gate: For an interpretation beyond common-mean calibration, the target-cluster interval for within-batch/split cardiac ranking must support positive correlation, and predicted-versus-reference upper-quintile overlap must exceed the same-pool random expectation K/M with a positive interval. Absolute-program error must improve in the same direction as delta error. Reference-positive upper-quintile sensitivity is also reported without changing the candidate pool. A stronger ranking/selection-improvement claim requires paired gains over raw/shrinkage, not merely failure to detect a decline.
known_response: Separate predesignated Calr analysis uses existing sealed D14 leave-batch predictions, all4 batches and all8 cardiac genes, with source mean/noOT references. Calr is not eligible for5+10 lowcoverage queries and is a published positive reference. Evaluate accurate program ranking/direction separately from gene-level amplitude. This is consistency evidence, not independent functional validation or a new discovery.
stop: One frozen task with20 splits and5/10-cell budgets. Do not search alternate modules, states, subgroups, budgets or models after results. Document and repair implementation errors without altering scientific gates. Preserve null/negative outcomes.
